g.title: W_PARK
g.text: Observed blue → parking light (some docs list red).

g.title: W_FUEL
g.text: 2x1.5 parallel → same pin at the pump

g.title: W_BRAKE
g.text: Observed red → brake light M9+M10 (some docs list blue).

g.title: PARK_SPLIT
g.text: X number plate grounded via GND.REAR.BUS

g.title: G6_PUMP
g.text: black+brown join to the SAME pin (+12V) at the pump. Separate GND pin → chassis (cable not drawn).
